info.name: API Reference agentic-search > agenticSearch video-scores > videoScores API
Get shot scores for a video

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the Dynamic Tag group.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: The ID of the tag within the group.

params.name: version_id
params.description: The tag version ID.

params.name: video_id
params.description: The Coactive Video ID to retrieve shot scores for.

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: Dataset ID (used to locate the shot scores table).

params.name: min_conf
params.description: Minimum confidence threshold (score >= min_conf). Must be greater than 0.1.

items.docs: Retrieve shot-level scores for a given video and tag version: score, start/end time, and duration for each shot (only shots with score >= min_conf).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the Dynamic Tag group.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: The ID of the tag within the group.

params.name: aggregation_id
params.description: The ID of the aggregation to retrieve results for.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed).

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items per page.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for scores (ascending or descending).

items.docs: Retrieve video scores based on an existing aggregation ID with pagination support.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the Dynamic Tag group.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: The ID of the tag within the group.

params.name: aggregation_id
params.description: The ID of the aggregation to retrieve count for.

params.name: criteria_met
params.description: Filter by whether criteria were met.

params.name: accepted
params.description: Filter by whether the score was accepted.

items.docs: Retrieve the count of video scores based on an aggregation ID with filtering options.

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the Dynamic Tag group.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: The ID of the tag within the group.

params.name: tag_version_id
params.description: The version ID of the tag.

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The ID of the dataset to query.

params.name: strategy
params.description: The aggregation strategy/methodology to use.

params.name: min_conf
params.description: Minimum confidence threshold.

params.name: coverage_threshold
params.description: Coverage threshold (required for COVERAGE_THRESHOLD strategy).

params.name: engine
params.description: Backend engine used to query shot scores. DUCKDB (default) supports all strategies; PINOT supports ANY_HIT and COVERAGE_THRESHOLD only.

params.name: max_shot_length
params.description: Maximum shot length in seconds. Videos with any shot longer than this value are excluded from results. Omit or set to null to disable filtering.

items.docs: Retrieve a preview of video scores based on aggregation strategy. Use this endpoint to preview results before creating an aggregation.
